auth.footer: New to the console? Use the link in your invitation email.
auth.notConnected: Sign-in isn’t connected yet. It arrives with the Platform API.

credentials.title: Sign in to the partner console
credentials.body: For partner teams. Merchants sign in at their partner’s portal.
credentials.missing: Enter your work email and password.
credentials.refused: That email or password isn’t right.

code.title: Enter your 2-factor code
code.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the code for DripFunnel Partners.
code.hint: Sign in turns on once all 6 digits are in.
code.incomplete: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
code.expired: That code has expired. Open your authenticator app for the current one.
code.locked: Too many wrong codes. To protect your account, signing in is paused for {minutes} minutes. We’ve emailed you about it.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your work email. If there’s an account, we’ll send a reset link.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If there’s an account for {email}, we’ve sent a link to reset the password. It works for 30 minutes.

expired.title: Your session expired
expired.body: You were signed out after 12 hours to keep the console safe. Sign in again and you’ll come back to this page. Nothing you saved was lost.

acceptInvite.title: Join {partner}
acceptInvite.bodyOwner: DripFunnel invited you to be the Owner of {partner}’s partner console. Set your name and password to accept.
acceptInvite.bodyMember: {inviter} invited you to {partner}’s partner console. Set your name and password to accept.
acceptInvite.invitedBy: Invited by {inviter}. The email can’t be changed.
acceptInvite.name: Your name
acceptInvite.weak: Enter your name and a password of at least 10 characters.

twoFactor.title: Set up 2-factor
twoFactor.bodyRequired: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows. You’ll need it every time you sign in.
twoFactor.bodyOptional: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows. You can skip this and set it up later.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.keyLabel: Can’t scan it? Enter this key:
twoFactor.wrong: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.required: Your partner requires 2-factor for everyone on the team. Set it up to continue.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitation links work for 7 days. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

used.title: This invitation has already been used
used.body: Each link works once. If you already joined, sign in. If not, ask whoever invited you for a new link.

replaced.title: This invitation was replaced
replaced.body: A newer invitation was sent, so this link no longer works. Use the latest email, or ask whoever invited you for a new link.

invalid.title: This link doesn’t work
invalid.body: Open the link from your invitation email, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.

navFooter.after: . This console is only for your team.

search.notYet: Search arrives with the Stores screen.

dev.name: Dev
dev.warning: Test data. Nothing here reaches real merchants

feature.name: Feature
feature.warning: Test data. Nothing here reaches real merchants

local.name: Local
local.warning: Test data. Nothing here reaches real merchants

draft.text: Draft: merchants can’t sign up yet. Finish the setup checklist and submit it for approval.

awaiting.text: Awaiting approval: DripFunnel is reviewing your contract, KYC and setup. Merchants can’t sign up yet.

sentback.text: Sent back: DripFunnel needs a change before approving you.

stores.title: Stores
stores.lede: Your merchants’ store accounts. Their orders, customers and products stay theirs.

plans.title: Plans
plans.lede: What your merchants can buy, within DripFunnel’s maximums.

branding.title: Branding
branding.lede: How your merchant portal and every email to your merchants and their suppliers look.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lede: Totals over time. No report lists an order, customer or product.

billing.title: Billing
billing.lede: Your merchants’ payments, your payouts and DripFunnel’s invoices, kept apart.

support.title: Support
support.lede: Sign in as one of your merchants’ users to fix things with them. 30 minutes, logged as you acting as them.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.lede: Everything done in this console and on your store accounts. Never what happens inside a store.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Your company, team, payouts and security.

gallery.title: Screen states
gallery.intro: Every state a screen can show, without an API. Add ?state= to any screen’s address to see it in one state.

empty.title: No stores yet
empty.body: Stores appear here as merchants sign up under your brand. Create the first one and invite its owner.

error.title: We couldn’t load your stores
error.body: The partner service didn’t answer in time. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

denied.reason: Your role (Support) can’t suspend stores. Owners and Admins can.

readonly.title: You have read-only access
readonly.body: Your role can see everything here but can’t change anything. Ask an Owner if you need to.

confirm.title: Suspend this store?
confirm.consequence: Suspends Loom & Thread. Its storefront shows a notice and its team can’t sign in until you restore it.
notes: Nothing is deleted. You can restore it at any time.
Its 14 open orders stay as they are.
confirm.reasonHint: Required. Suspend store turns on once you give a reason.
confirm.typeHint: Type the store name exactly to confirm.

settings.accountSub: What a staff session can’t change is turned off here, with the reason.

blocked.BLOCKED_WHILE_IMPERSONATING: Support can’t change this while signed in as {user}.

staffSession.endFailed: That didn’t end the session. Try again, or end it from the admin console.
staffSession.back: Back to the admin console (keeps running)
staffSession.notice: Support ({staff}) is signed in as {user}. Ends in {time}.
staffSession.noticeSetup: DripFunnel is setting up your console: {staff}, until {time}.

endedBody.admin: It was ended from the DripFunnel admin console. Everything saved stays.
endedBody.portal: You ended it here. The admin console has been updated. Everything saved stays.
endedBody.expiry: The session timed out. Everything saved stays. Start a new one from the admin console if you need more time.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.body: Staff session links work once, from the DripFunnel admin console. Start a new session there.
